common_teacher_model_identity.model: released Fast-WAM Optional-IDM clean checkpoint; idm mode

paired_comparison.delta_definition: C80 minus C8; negative RMSE change favors C80

focus_gripper.selection_basis: Cases were fixed from preliminary C8 findings before this comparison; diagnostic only, not method selection.
focus_gripper.metric: Saved first10 gripper RMSE versus the same-input, same-seed BF16 teacher.
focus_gripper.maximum_difference_definition: Maximum absolute gripper output difference over the first 10 normalized output steps; step index is zero-based.
focus_gripper.step_interpretation: A normalized output difference only; it does not establish an executed action or closed-loop failure.

three_case_mean.aggregation: Equal mean of the three per-case means; each case mean averages its two seeds.

method.name: Microscaling additive VQ decoded BF16 with dynamic A4 inputs

transform.name: smooth05_hadamard
transform.source: reuse exact saved transforms from original successful full banks; no refitting or alpha search

microscaling.axis: input dimension within each output row
microscaling.row_gain: reuse exact existing BF16 row RMS
microscaling.books_shared: two books shared within each Linear
microscaling.metric: same A4 input diagonal second moment multiplied by actual block scale squared

evidence_boundary.reference: shared BF16 teacher, same input and sampler seed
evidence_boundary.claim_scope: Calibration cohort comparison for decoded-BF16 B32 additive VQ; C8 vs C80 changes task/context/phase coverage; no unseen-task, native kernel, speed or closed-loop claim

query_timing_diagnostic.scope: per-query input load/datum preparation plus decoded-BF16 model inference
query_timing_diagnostic.interpretation: descriptive only; not a benchmark or latency claim; no native low-bit kernel
